name: charts-4
title: Monthly Visitors Line
description: Line chart card plotting unique visitors month by month, with a grid, labeled axes, and a hover tooltip on each point.

standards.purpose: Make a trend comparable at a glance without distorting the data.
useWhen: A series over time or a share of a whole must be read quickly.
doNotUseWhen: Exact values must be compared row by row (use a table).

rules.check: Axes state what they measure and in which unit; a truncated axis is labeled as such.
The chart has a text alternative summarizing the trend and key values.
Series colors come from chart tokens, never raw hex values.
Displayed series are real or clearly labeled sample data.
